verdict.rationale: Unleash's automation layer is release management: release templates, automated milestone progression, and safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold. That gives a rollback-like safety net. Change requests add an approval step before changes reach an environment, which covers review. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning or history of these automations, and review is described at the environment-change level rather than for automation definitions specifically. Missing for 10: version history or audit trail for automations/release templates, explicit point-in-time rollback of automation configuration, review applied to automation definitions themselves, independent or hands-on corroboration.
